rows.vgi.doc_llm: Search Wikipedia, read article summaries and enrich local SQL data with Wikidata knowledge. Article identity links encyclopedic text to structured entities; statements preserve typed values, ranks, qualifiers and sources. Graph queries express relationships using remote SPARQL. rows.vgi.doc_md:
# Wikipedia and Wikidata in SQL

Connect encyclopedic articles to structured knowledge and join the results to local SQL tables. Use it for retrieval-augmented generation, fact lookup and entity enrichment. Article identity provides a reliable bridge to Wikidata without guessing from similar labels.

## Data and context

Statements retain their rank, typed value, qualifiers and reference sources. Source revisions help identify observations taken at different times. Remote SPARQL supports graph patterns and property paths; RDF terms retain their lexical value, datatype and language. Results are bounded and cached locally.

## Access

The worker calls the free [MediaWiki API](https://www.mediawiki.org/wiki/API:Main_page) and [Wikibase API](https://www.mediawiki.org/wiki/Wikibase/API). No API key is required. Queries require outbound access; language and endpoint options select the upstream site. Public endpoint availability and dataset coverage affect results.

Worker code is MIT. Wikipedia article text is **CC-BY-SA**; callers handle attribution and share-alike requirements. Wikidata structured data is **CC0**. Custom endpoints have their own terms.
